consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: near hit during an intrusive maintenance task on HT-9005

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HT-9005 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9005 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 12 March 2005 a near hit was recorded on HT-9005 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
